title: Jack in the Box NNN | Conditional property decision dashboard
scope: Anonymous Jack in the Box NNN property, user-described as around central Los Angeles; exact address deliberately omitted.

recommendation.status: Conditional dual-track process; final hold/sell choice is not supportable from the supplied property facts.
recommendation.headline: Protect the downside. Preserve the option to sell.
recommendation.summary: Do not blindly hold to expiry or assume renewal. Start a confidential market-value and buyer-interest check while reviewing the executed lease and negotiating a tenant-supported extension. Favor a sale only when an executable, same-basis net sale value exceeds a conservative hold value plus an explicit, non-duplicated uncertainty/liquidity buffer. Favor an extension only when its incremental value exceeds added landlord obligations, retained risks and the sale alternative.
rationale: The county is large but not uniformly growing: Census estimates a 3.2% population decline from April 2020 to July 2025; the official county long-run outlook has approximately flat population and modest payroll growth.

The brand remains substantial, but the latest issuer filing reports negative system/franchise comparable sales, closures, tight liquidity and elevated leverage. Brand scale is not a substitute for the actual franchisee's rent coverage.

NNN shifts many operating expenses, not all credit, vacancy, re-leasing, hazard, insurance, tax, liquidity or residual-value risks. A long lease can stabilize income while also locking in below-market rent or limiting reuse.
The 2030–2035 expiry range is a user claim, not a verified lease fact. No rent, price, executed option, guaranty, parcel hazard or tenant financial statement was supplied.
next_actions: Obtain the executed lease, amendments, options, estoppel, guaranties and actual rent roll through a private diligence channel; do not upload personal or confidential documents to this public site.
Obtain independent current appraisal and executable buyer indications, current parcel-level hazard/insurance review, and franchisee rent coverage. Keep identities out of public artifacts.
Populate a private, same-basis after-tax comparison; use the public normalized model only to understand sensitivities and set disciplined thresholds.

methodology.normalization: Initial annual contractual base rent R0 = 100 monetary units. This is a scale convention, not a property rent estimate. Results are multiples of actual verified R0 once available.
methodology.timing: 120 end-of-month cash flows over ten years. Annual effective discount and rent escalation are converted by exponentiation, not divided by twelve. Re-letting cost is paid at the expiry month; downtime begins after expiry. These are modeling conventions, not observed lease terms.
methodology.post_expiry: Renewal resets rent relative to initial R0, with no downtime or releasing cost in this idealized path. Re-letting applies a reset, downtime and releasing cost. Vacant paths retain only an explicit residual-rent-multiple hypothesis. Renewal is not unilateral: tenant consent and executed documentation are required.
methodology.valuation: Unlevered, pre-owner-income-tax property value. Terminal value = final-year net rent / exit cap, less terminal selling cost; vacant path uses residual hypothesis. Compare with gross sale price less selling costs BEFORE debt payoff and owner income taxes. Then separately test the owner's actual after-debt, after-tax equity proceeds and reinvestment alternatives.
methodology.interpretation: Scenarios are conditional stress tests, not probability-weighted expected values, confidence intervals, market cap-rate estimates or forecasts of this property's rent. No annual interpolation of official five-year averages is performed. Regional earthquake probabilities are not building-loss or tenant-default probabilities.
decision_rules: LEAN SELL: executable net sale value before debt/owner tax ≥ conservative hold PV + explicit uncertainty/liquidity buffer, after separately checking owner taxes, debt/prepayment, guarantees and reinvestment needs.
LEAN HOLD / PLAN EXIT: the sale test fails and liquidity reserves cover landlord obligations, vacancy and tail losses; reassess at each evidence update.

PURSUE EXTENSION: PV(extension) − PV(existing hold) > incremental concessions, landlord carve-outs and retained-risk burden, AND the extended position remains competitive with the sale alternative. Do not count the same risk in both the discount rate and a cash-flow/risk-buffer deduction.
NO FINAL CHOICE: any critical lease, rent, executable sale value, tenant-credit or tax/debt input remains unknown. The dashboard deliberately returns no property-specific best price.
